prompt: Add a decorative save icon next to the Save button text.
expected: Use an SVG with aria-hidden='true' and focusable='false' beside the visible Save label.
actual: Added an inline SVG inside the button with aria-hidden='true' and focusable='false', leaving the visible Save text as the accessible name.

prompt: Create a standalone icon-only button for search.
expected: Provide an accessible name via aria-label or visually hidden text; keep the SVG aria-hidden.
actual: Created a button with aria-label='Search' and an inner SVG marked aria-hidden='true' focusable='false'.

prompt: Make toolbar icons follow the button text color on hover without editing each SVG fill.
expected: Use fill='currentColor' or stroke='currentColor' so CSS color drives icon color.
actual: Switched icon paths to currentColor and set button color/hover color in CSS; icons inherit automatically.
